title: Deep Tech Startups Need Milestone-Literate Investors
primary_theme: Deep tech investing requires technical diligence and patient milestone interpretation
secondary_themes: Hardware and deep tech capital gaps
founder_lessons: Deep tech founders need investors who understand why technical milestones matter even before revenue or customers appear.
Show that the technology solves a fundamental industry problem and can become a real product.
Build enough technology before approaching investors whose strength is technical diligence.
Use the investor to pressure-test both the product and go-to-market path, because both can make or break deep tech companies.
notable_quotes: The investor needs to understand and appreciate the technology.
Are you solving a fundamental big problem that the industry or the ecosystem needs?
there's not enough people that will actually go evaluate.
